description: This Java class defines a Fragment called LogFragment that displays logs in a custom LogView inside a ScrollView. It manages view inflation, styling, and user interactions related to the log display.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates a log display view using LogView and ScrollView to append and view logs.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Creates and configures the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and LogView, setting styles and layout parameters.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment lifecycle method to inflate views and add a TextWatcher to auto-scroll when logs are updated.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within this fragment.
